title: Meet 5-star Calvin Ashley: The Future of Auburn's Offensive Line
description:
When Calvin Ashley walks into a room, he dominates it. Standing at 6'7 and weighing nearly 300 pounds, Ashley is one of the nation's top overall recruits and holds a 5-star ranking from all of the major recruiting websites.

However, as striking as the numbers surrounding the offensive tackle are, it's the intangibles of the man behind them that will leave a lasting impact at Auburn.

AL.com's Justin King (http://twitter.com/JustinKing) sat down with Calvin, as well as those closest to him, to produce the video above and show why the future of Auburn's offensive line is bright.

Calvin has been committed to the Auburn Tigers for some time, and as you'll see if the video, he plans to stay that way. One quick glance at his highlights and you'll see why he is one of the top overall recruits in the entire country and very deserving of his 5 star ranking.
author: Auburn Tigers on AL.com
